    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDetails" name="Review complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineOutcome" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of complaint validity and refund decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Log" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Log_Assign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assign_Review" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Determine" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDetails" targetRef="Task_DetermineOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Determine_Notify" sourceRef="Task_DetermineOutcome" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_Resolved" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Mark_End" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Complaint decision" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Organization" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
